name: National Gallery of Canada
description: Explore historical and contemporary paintings, sculpture, and photography. A substantial indoor visit for visual-art enthusiasts near the ByWard Market.

name: Ottawa Art Gallery
description: Browse changing visual-art exhibitions in a downtown gallery. A useful indoor cultural activity for visitors on a small budget.

name: Canadian War Museum
description: Explore Canadian military history through artifacts, personal stories, artwork, and vehicles. Suits visitors interested in conflict, remembrance, and its effects on society.

name: Canadian Museum of History
description: Explore Canadian history and cultural heritage across the river in Gatineau. A substantial museum visit about the people and events that shaped Canada.

name: Canadian Museum of Nature
description: Discover natural history in a heritage building, with exhibitions ranging from dinosaurs to climate change. Suits visitors interested in science and the natural world.

name: Canada Aviation and Space Museum
description: Explore aircraft collections and achievements in space. An indoor destination for visitors interested in flight, engineering, and transportation history.

name: Canada Science and Technology Museum
description: Discover Canadian inventions through exhibitions and interactive science demonstrations. Suits visitors who enjoy hands-on learning and technological innovation.

name: Diefenbunker: Canada's Cold War Museum
description: Explore a former underground Cold War headquarters and government emergency planning. Located in Carp outside central Ottawa; allow extra travel time.

name: Canada Agriculture and Food Museum
description: Explore a working farm and exhibitions about agriculture and food production. The experience combines indoor and outdoor spaces, so weather matters.

name: Major's Hill Park
description: Walk among lawns and trees with views of the Ottawa River and nearby landmarks. Historical interpretation and scenery make this a useful break between museum visits.

name: Rideau Falls Park and Green Island
description: View the twin waterfalls where the Rideau River meets the Ottawa River. A short outdoor stop for waterfall photography and commemorative monuments.

name: Kìwekì Point
description: Enjoy panoramic views of Parliament Hill and Ottawa-Gatineau behind the National Gallery. Paths and public art suit a short scenic visit.

name: Confederation Park
description: Take a brief downtown walk among mature trees, sculptures, and commemorative monuments. Suits a short outdoor break with an interest in public history.

name: Hog's Back Park
description: Explore waterfall views, riverside scenery, and historical displays in an urban nature park. Suits an outdoor walk and landscape photography. Access is seasonal.

name: Jacques-Cartier Park
description: Walk through a riverside park in Gatineau with views toward Ottawa. An outdoor complement to a nearby Museum of History visit.

name: Rockcliffe Park and the Rockeries
description: Explore scenic lookouts, a pavilion, and landscaped areas with seasonal flowers. Suits garden enthusiasts and outdoor photographers. Access is seasonal.

name: Garden of the Provinces and Territories
description: Explore landscaped gardens inspired by Canadian landscapes and horticulture. Suits a short garden walk or an outdoor break near downtown.

name: Remic Rapids Park
description: Visit an Ottawa River park known for balanced rock sculptures and shoreline views. Combines outdoor art, nature, and photography; the experience varies with the season.
